Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Program Synthesis with Large Language Models (2108.07732v1) · paper method: The authors manually inspected, edited and pruned MBPP into a 426-question edited subset; their original-versus-edited evaluation compares 100 overlapping questions.

cohort4.claim.mbpp.edited-subset

  • This assertion originated as an author proposal; separate review receipts determine its current status.
  • Version-specific author-reported method; no experiment, dataset-record audit or formal proof was independently reproduced.
  • The edited subset and original dataset are separate manifestations within one benchmark family.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Program Synthesis with Large Language Models (2108.07732v1) · paper method: MBPP was constructed by an internal pool of crowdworkers with basic Python knowledge who supplied a problem statement, a self-contained reference function and three semantic test cases per problem; the original collection has 974 problems.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Program Synthesis with Large Language Models (2108.07732v1) · paper method: The authors’ whitespace-normalized line-overlap analysis found 32 of 974 MBPP reference programs with more than half their eligible lines matched in a pretraining document.

cohort4.claim.mbpp.overlap-check

  • This assertion originated as an author proposal; separate review receipts determine its current status.
  • Version-specific author-reported method; no experiment, dataset-record audit or formal proof was independently reproduced.
  • The check excludes non-English and conversational pretraining documents and lines appearing more than twice in MBPP; it is not proof of contamination absence.
